mono.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

grid.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

header.instructions: Sticky header (z-50) with logo, navigation links, and auto-refresh toggle/indicator.

card.instructions: Use flat background, 1px subtle border. No excessive shadows. For interactive cards, add hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200.

button.primary: bg-[#019581] hover:bg-[#017d6c] text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
button.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
button.danger: bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

table.instructions: Dense table layout. Left align text, center align status badges/icons.

status_badge.critical: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.warning: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.success: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.info: bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badge.unknown: bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border border-gray-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons for dense dashboard readability. Provide the command `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` for the main agent.

motion.instructions: Minimalist animations. Use micro-interactions for feedback on buttons and table rows.

ExecutiveOverview.instructions: Bento grid layout. Top row: Key Metrics (Health Score, Total Count, Critical Incidents). Middle row: Top failing integrations list and API Latency sparkline. Auto-refresh indicator in the header.

IntegrationList.instructions: Full-width data table. Filterable by status, project, domain. Clickable rows to navigate to Detail page.

IntegrationDetail.instructions: Grid layout. Left column (span 2): Integration metadata, run history, API latency logs. Right column (span 1): Status panel, error recommendations rules engine output.

Settings.instructions: Simple form layout for future OIC configurations. Use Shadcn-like form inputs.

testing.instructions: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements. e.g. `data-testid="auto-refresh-toggle"`, `data-testid="integration-row-1"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. No need for complex Shadcn setups unless utilizing raw HTML/Tailwind.
Implement 30s auto-refresh interval using standard React `useEffect` and `setInterval`.
Implement rules engine visually as a priority list (top 3) in the detail view.
Apply Badger Green (#019581) strictly to nav, buttons, table headers, and accents as requested.
Apply Badger Green Dark (#016B5E) strictly to section headings.
Implement API latency logging view using Recharts if possible, or simple styled HTML bars.
Add the benchmark script in Python or Shell as requested in the root directory.
